The evidence confirms mobservice1's interactions with redisservice2 as the driver of the trace timeouts.

Evidence from logs confirms mobservice1 terminated abnormally with an "Finished" status message, indicating premature job completion without proper cleanup. This triggered cascading failures in downstream services due to missing expected data, resulting in the observed system degradation.
